_about: Zero-data / cold-start keyword universe for en.rentbikehanoi.com. Every row is a demand estimate from a third-party search index read through the OpenRush connector on the date given (no Google Search Console, GA4 or rank data exists yet). Volumes are the index's monthly estimates per market (us, uk, au, vn = English queries made from that country); they are evidence for prioritisation, never facts to publish. Rows were kept only when on-topic (relevance core = Hanoi/Vietnam motorbike, scooter, rental, licence or riding; adjacent = Vietnam riding context without the vehicle word; other-city = rental intent for a city the business does not serve; competitor-brand = another rental brand's name, never a target). Off-topic rows returned by the tools (food, cost of living, Top Gear, other countries, US state licence rules) were dropped. scripts/english-seo-matrix.js maps each row to the URL that serves it and writes docs/seo/keyword-universe.md.
_rules: Never invent or round volumes; copy the tool value with its market and date.
Competitor brand names are recorded for SERP understanding only and are never targeted in titles, headings or copy.
No new articles are created for gaps (production plan complete): a gap is served inside the nearest existing URL or left as REVIEW_REQUIRED for the owner.
Replace or supplement this file with Search Console data when it exists (DATA-DRIVEN mode, see README).
